verdict.rationale: The Search API response schema includes a "subpages" field alongside each result (exa-docs-37), which suggests first-party support for returning subpage content from a search hit. The Contents API extracts clean page content from given URLs (exa-docs-24), but that is per-URL extraction, not crawling. Domain/path filters (exa-docs-13) only restrict search results, so they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit. missing for 10: documentation of how subpage crawling is requested and its parameters (count, depth, targeting), any whole-site crawl capability, examples of crawl output, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
